description: Fork of exp693 (1.4379 @ 97.5M, <100M SOTA). Single addition: an emb_resid_lut TinyMHLut(NAP=5, tph=256, n_heads=1, n_out=D=384) applied to MeanAbsNorm(tok_emb_E(tokens)) and written directly to the D-stream. The D-stream becomes 7 contributions (1 from bare embedding + 6 from per-layer residual_luts). Alternative to exp695's pre_lut: instead of transforming the E-stream (which affects all downstream blocks), give the unembedder a direct view of the bare embedding. Same shape as per-layer residual_lut. Param impact: +3.15M -> 100.67M total. Refs: exp693=1.4379 @ 97.5M, exp695 (pre_lut)=in-flight (killed at step 4200=1.5161), exp684=1.4262 @ 140M.
